description_en: Sets property values for multiple devices in a batch
description_zh: 调用该接口批量设置设备属性值
kebab_example: aliyun iot set-devices-property --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --items Switch_:1,_Color_:_blue --device-name example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDevicesProperty

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If the ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the devices whose property values you want to set belong
parameters.help_zh: 要设置属性值的设备所属的产品ProductKey
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The property information to set, in JSON format.

Each property is specified as a key:value pair, where the key is the identifier and the value is the property value. Separate multiple properties with commas (,).

For example, to set two properties of a smart light:
A switch property with the identifier Switch, data type Bool, and value 1 (on).
A color property with the identifier Color, data type String, and value blue.

The JSON format of the property information is as follows:

`Items={"Switch":1,"Color":"blue"}`

To set properties of a custom module testFb (non-default module), use the following format: `Items={"testFb:Switch":1,"testFb:Color":"blue"}`
parameters.help_zh:
要设置的属性信息，数据格式为JSON。

每个属性信息由标识符与属性值（key:value）构成，多个属性用英文逗号隔开。

例如，设置智能灯的两个属性：
标识符为Switch的开关属性，数据类型为Bool，设置值为1（开）。
标识符为Color的灯颜色属性，数据类型为String，设置值为blue。

那么要设置的属性信息，JSON格式如下：

`Items={"Switch":1,"Color":"blue"}`

如果设置自定义模块testFb（非默认模块）的属性，则格式为：`Items={"testFb:Switch":1,"testFb:Color":"blue"}`
parameters.name: items

parameters.help_en: The list of device names for which you want to set property values. The number of device names ranges from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 要设置属性值的设备名称列表。设备名称的个数范围为1~100个
parameters.name: device_name
